Question 2
?

Find the first two non-zero terms of the Maclaurin expansion of the function f(x)=πcos⁡(πx).

a
πcos⁡(πx)=πx−π3x36+⋯
b
πcos⁡(πx)=1−π2x22+⋯
c
πcos⁡(πx)=πx+π3x36+⋯
d
πcos⁡(πx)=π−πx23+⋯
e
πcos⁡(πx)=π−π3x22+⋯
